results.title: Fearmongering around fake drugs

results.title: India needs a comprehensive doctrine on space security
results.content: India’s objective should not be to turn outer space into another arena of conflict, but to ensure that disruption in space does not translate into vulnerability on Earth

results.title: Transgender rights, healthcare should not be compromised
results.content: Clinical understanding of the care needs of a transgender person remains rudimentary in India. Doctors, nurses, receptionists, security staff and hospital administrators need to be trained in basic transgender health.
